headline: PM Tarique Rahman leaves for Tokyo on 4-day state visit to Japan
summary: The Prime Minister is leading a 15-member delegation to meet Japanese PM Sanae Takaichi and strengthen bilateral ties.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman departed from Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka around 12:15 am on Monday for a four-day state visit to Japan.
The Prime Minister is traveling on a Biman Bangladesh Airlines commercial flight, accompanied by his wife, Zubaida Rahman.
The visit comes at the invitation of Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, where the PM will lead a high-level 15-member delegation.

The delegation includes key officials such as Finance and Planning Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury, Finance and Planning Advisor Rashed Al Mahmud Titumir, and State Minister for Foreign Affairs Humaiun Kobir.
Also accompanying the PM are State Minister for Power Aninda Islam Amit, Telecoms Advisor Rehan Asif Asad, and Bangladesh Bank Governor Mostaqur Rahman.
The delegation further includes representatives from the Investment Development Authority, the Foreign Secretary, and senior officials from the government and foreign ministry.
Notably, the group also includes Azizul Haque Islamabadi of Hifazat e-Islam and Md Tarek Rahman of the Amjanatar Dal.

headline_marked: Rangpur: [[Two killed in mob beating]] over alleged auto-rickshaw theft
headline: Rangpur: Two killed in mob beating over alleged auto-rickshaw theft
summary: The victims were chased by locals after a mosque loudspeaker announcement warned of the theft early yesterday morning.
details: Two men were beaten to death by a mob in Rangpur’s Gangachara upazila early yesterday, police said.
The deceased were identified as Ejarul Haque, 46, and Sadikul Islam, 25.
The incident began when a resident, Sohel Mia, noticed an auto-rickshaw being stolen from his house and raised an alarm.
A nearby mosque’s loudspeaker was used to warn residents about the suspected theft, prompting locals to chase the suspects.
The two men abandoned the vehicle on the road and attempted to escape through a paddy field, where they were caught by the mob.
Witnesses stated that the men were beaten to death on the spot.
Abdus Sabur, officer-in-charge of Gangachara Model Police Station, stated that the bodies will be sent to Rangpur Medical College Hospital for autopsies.
